privacy.title: Privacy Notice (KVKK)
privacy.intro: This notice explains how your personal data is processed under Turkish Personal Data Protection Law No. 6698 (KVKK).
privacy.controller: The data controller is [Platform operator]. Address and contact details: [Platform operator address/contact].
privacy.purpose: To create and manage your account, to provide export-readiness services using your company and product details, and to keep the service secure.
privacy.basis: KVKK Article 5: performance of a contract, legal obligation, legitimate interest and, where needed, your explicit consent.
privacy.rights: You may learn whether your data is processed, request information, ask for correction or deletion, object to processing, and claim compensation for damage.
privacy.contact: Send your requests to [Platform operator contact email].
privacy.placeholderNote: Fields in square brackets must be completed by the platform operator before launch.
